CommunityApplications.Profile:
The official Unraid template for **Nostos**, a self-hosted home for your reading life: books, EPUBs, PDFs and audiobooks, with notes, highlights and a writing studio. Maintained by the Nostos developer, Christian Gennari.
The template runs the official image, `ghcr.io/christian-gennari/nostos`. Its source is in the Nostos repository under `deploy/app-stores/unraid/`.
For help, open an issue at https://github.com/Christian-Gennari/Nostos/issues. Documentation: https://docs.nostos.page.
